preconditions.description: The length of the binary representation of r must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The lengths of the binary representations of l and r must both be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in l) and all(c in '01' for c in r)
preconditions.description: Both l and r must consist only of binary digits (0 and 1).
The decimal value of l must be less than or equal to the decimal value of r.

postconditions.description: The output must be the binary representation of f(l, r) without leading zeros.
